Patna ki AG koloni men uchch shiksha mantri sanjay taigar ke ghar chori huee. chor 600 gram sona, 2 kilo chandi aur 7 lakh rupye kaish chura le gae. ab pulis CCTV phutej khangal rahi hai. parhen mantri ke ghar chori ki kahani.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
